Demo-only browser libraries, vendored from pinned npm packages.
Chart.js 4.5.1: chart.umd.js, MIT, chart-LICENSE.txt.
jsPDF 4.2.1: jspdf.umd.min.js, MIT, jspdf-LICENSE.txt.
The demo loads these files locally to avoid external CDN/provider requests.
Update from the exact package versions in package-lock.json and retain licenses.
